brief: Assign a value to a defined variable
description: Compiler internal: an assignment statement (x = value) compiles to assign. It assigns to the innermost structured block definition of the variable, or defines it in the innermost structured block if there is none. It is not meant to be called by name: assign("x", 5) throws "Invalid assignment target". To merge objects, use object spread ({...a, ...b}).

parameters.description: This is the value to assign to the variable.
parameters.name: value
